content.user_title: Enable Continuous Learning for Session Insights
content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can lose useful decisions and patterns. This skill turns on automatic insight capture into a local knowledge base.
actual_capabilities: Guides the assistant to read knowledge/state.json before changing learning state.
Sets learning_mode to true and stores the current activation timestamp.
Resets the query counter used for automatic extraction thresholds.
Documents automatic extraction after 10 queries or 30 minutes of activity.
Shows users where extracted patterns, quirks, and decisions will be saved.
limitations: Requires a router or workflow that reads knowledge/state.json.
Does not extract insights by itself when the router is absent.
Learning mode is documented as session scoped and resets on new sessions.
Depends on related commands for manual extraction, status, and disabling.

use_cases.title: Capture Long Debugging Sessions
use_cases.description: Enable automatic learning while investigating repeated bugs and implementation decisions.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Working Memory
use_cases.description: Record patterns and preferences during extended collaboration with an AI assistant.

use_cases.title: Build Workflow Notes
use_cases.description: Keep operational quirks and decisions available for future sessions.

output_examples.input: Enable continuous learning for this session.
output_examples.output: Continuous learning is enabled. Automatic extraction will run after the configured query or time threshold.

output_examples.input: Turn on learning before we continue the architecture review.
output_examples.output: Learning mode is active. Future patterns, quirks, and decisions will be saved to the knowledge files.

output_examples.input: Start automatic insight capture and tell me how to stop it later.
output_examples.output: Continuous learning is enabled. Use the matching off command to disable it, or run manual learning when needed.

best_practices: Enable the skill before long sessions where decisions may accumulate.
Review saved learning files after important milestones.
Use manual extraction when a major insight should be captured immediately.
anti_patterns: Do not expect learning capture without the router state workflow.
Do not leave learning mode on when session notes should stay temporary.
Do not use this as a replacement for deliberate documentation reviews.

faq.question: What does this skill enable?
faq.answer: It enables continuous learning mode for automatic insight extraction during a session.

faq.question: Where does it store learning state?
faq.answer: The instructions use knowledge/state.json to store learning mode, timestamp, and query count.

faq.question: When does extraction run?
faq.answer: The documented threshold is every 10 queries or every 30 minutes of activity.

faq.question: Does this skill perform extraction itself?
faq.answer: No. It enables the state that a compatible router uses to trigger extraction.

faq.question: Can users still run manual learning?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill notes that manual learning can still run while continuous mode is active.

faq.question: Is this suitable for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Claude Code, and Codex workflows.
